generations.prompt: Naturalistic footage of an ancient Mediterranean harbor town in late autumn. Overcast winter light, muted colors, soft contrast, real textures, nothing staged. Inside a small stone house at night, lit by a small clay oil lamp and the low glow of the hearth. A man in his mid-forties with a short dark beard going grey and a belted undyed wool tunic sits slumped on a stool against the wall beside the small dark window, asleep, his head back against the wall, eyes closed, mouth closed, a clay cup tipped over in his lap, a clay jug on the floor by his foot. He does not move except for slow breathing. A woman in her late thirties with dark hair pinned up under a plain cloth works at an upright loom in the lamplight, passing the thread and beating it down with the weaving sword in a slow steady rhythm. She does not look at him. Audio: rain on roof tiles, the soft regular thud of the loom, the fire settling. Camera is fixed, no camera movement. No music, no speech. No on-screen text, no captions, no watermark.
